title: A paused worker resumes after ownership changes
method: Synthetic timeline: a 30-second lease begins at t=0; a successor acquires at t=31 and writes at t=35; the paused old worker resumes at t=45. Bars show event timestamps, not durations or benchmark results. Storage-side fencing must reject the old generation.
alt: A paused worker resumes after ownership changes. Lease expiry: 30 seconds since acquisition; New owner acquired: 31 seconds since acquisition; New owner writes: 35 seconds since acquisition; Old owner resumes: 45 seconds since acquisition. Illustrative values.
